verdict.rationale: Connect documents payouts to connected accounts' external bank accounts, with automatic payout schedules and instant payouts, and one community member welcomes being able to pay out internationally as a marketplace. The pack says nothing about local-currency payouts, FX handling, or local bank rails versus wires, so only the generic payout core is evidenced. Older community posts about limited regional availability are dated and do not concretely contradict a documented claim. missing for 10: documented local-currency payouts, documented FX conversion/handling, evidence of settlement via local bank rails rather than wires, country/currency coverage details, independent hands-on corroboration.
